WHAT’S GETTING ATTENTION

City pulse. Less noise.

A small, date-aware edit of events, food, shops and culture. Evidence—not a claim to measure citywide popularity.

No Reddit or Instagram signals qualified this refresh. This edit uses dated publications and official supporting links; access limits are listed below.

events

Go to Hyperallergic Halloween at Oberon

A one-night art-costume party in Williamsburg with snacks, open bar and a judged costume competition; it is ticketed, so verify availability before building a night around it.

Report + official supportLatest signal 2026-10-13Event Wed, Oct 28
See the evidence

  • Official2026-10-13 · Event page gives Oberon, 196 N 10th Street, 7:00pm, and ticket details.
food

Put Buddy & Son on the late-October LES opening radar

A Gjelina-linked team is slated to open a French-American brasserie inside PUBLIC Hotel on October 26; useful for planning rather than same-week dining, since opening timelines can slip.

See the evidence

food

Visit Val’s for a new Red Hook diner-bar format

Brooklyn Magazine’s feed describes a newly opened Red Hook diner and bar from three hospitality veterans, with current Thursday–Sunday noon-to-midnight hours and more days expected later.

Single-source watchLatest signal 2026-10-12
See the evidence
  • Publication2026-10-12 · Feed item reports Val’s at 347 Van Brunt Street and current Thursday–Sunday noon-to-midnight hours.
shops

Watch Black Cat Wines’ Gowanus move before the old shop closes

The Gowanus wine shop is reportedly closing its current Fourth Avenue address sometime in October and moving one block away later this season; timing is loose, so confirm before making a special trip.

Single-source watchLatest signal 2026-10-09
See the evidence
  • Publication2026-10-09 · Reports Black Cat is closing 252 Fourth Avenue sometime in October and moving to 282 Fourth Avenue later this season.

Weekday lunch specials $14-$17 per Eater; official menu page confirms a weekday lunch special served with rice and soup of the day but did not expose individual item prices in captured text.

Open daily 11:30 AM-10:00 PM; lunch special Monday-Friday until 3:00 PM; weekend dim sum brunch from 11:00 AM per official homepage/menu evidence.

Conditions & sources

Conditions: Official menu says S.P. denotes seasonal/market price, prices are subject to change, and live-tank availability should be confirmed by phone. Sources: https://www.cantonharbor.com/menu.html; https://www.cantonharbor.com/; https://ny.eater.com/maps/best-new-queens-restaurants-heatmap

Expired offers are removed; updates older than seven days are hidden until rechecked.
